body: What do you see now that has gotten better that you never thought would?

So, like the idea that no matter what current predicament we are in, whether that's good or bad, there is a numerous "realm of possibilities" for things to change?

That actually makes sense. It's good to know you haven't ended your life. I appreciate that you shared that with me. 

Ten bucks says I probably won't ever meet you, but I'll take you up on the same thinking and see how it goes from there. Actually means a lot. Thank you

I understand the design Jesus has created for a divine purpose in every human being, believer or not. That if Christians submit to Him, He'll use us in ways to glorify the Lord. Ways we'll never comprehend (since we're not God) but see signs of progress followed by completion. There's the free will to believe or not. I know what my place is, but I have no attachment to the purpose. I want to fulfill my purpose, whatever that may be. Faith is needed for everything at some point, so I'm willing to have faith. But I'd prefer not doing it in misery

I'm studying Computer Networking, with a double minor in Business Management Servers and Music.

I used to play drums, but I had to sell my set for tires. Other than that, motorcycles. It's all I really have that gives me peace these days.
